name: What is accessible bathroom remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessible bathroom remodeling involves modifying a bathroom to be usable by individuals with disabilities or limited mobility. This can include wider doorways, grab bars, roll-in showers, comfort-height toilets, and accessible sink areas. The goal is to create a safe, functional, and independent bathing environment. These renovations prioritize ease of use and safety features tailored to individual needs, often going beyond basic code requirements to enhance quality of life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessible bathroom remodeling adapts bathrooms for individuals with disabilities or limited mobility, incorporating features like grab bars and roll-in showers.
